sinkhorn_distance — COLORTRANSPORT transport op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × matrix → scalar

• Call: import colortransport; colortransport.sinkhorn_distance(a, b, cost, reg=0.05, **kw) (or opscolortransport.get("sinkhorn_distance"))

Usage

The regularised transport cost `<plan, cost>`. Not a true distance.
